text: {Name} repaired bicycles near {Place} for underground couriers delivering medicine to hidden clinics. Police searched the workshop and seized the spare parts, leaving several couriers without working bicycles.
self_review: A bicycle repairer helped couriers supply hidden clinics until police seized the parts needed to keep their bicycles working.
source_pattern: The supplied Strobos testimony describes underground transport work and the importance and vulnerability of a bicycle at checkpoints.
fictional_changes: The repair shop, medical network, workshop search, and seized parts are invented extensions of the transport pattern.
